result.instructions: Tools for Taggun, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which merchants are saved as known merchants for matching receipts?"; "Read the receipt at https://example.com/receipt.jpg and list tax and total."; "Which receipt validation campaigns have I set up?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Taggun data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run taggun_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run taggun_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run taggun_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. taggun_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: taggun_scan_receipt_url
tools.title: Scan a receipt or invoice from a URL
tools.description: WRITE: this scan counts against YOUR Taggun quota and plan (free for the first 30 days or 1,000 scans, then billed per scan by Taggun), even if the receipt fails validation; it is never retried automatically. Document content is not logged by this server. Extract structured data (merchant, date, total, tax, and in verbose mode line items) from a receipt or invoice at a public https URL (JPEG, PNG, GIF, HEIF/HEIC or PDF up to 5 pages, max 20 MiB). The URL must be a public host name: no IP addresses, localhost, internal names, credentials or non-default ports. POST /api/receipt/v1/{simple|verbose}/url.

url.description: Public https URL of the receipt or invoice file.

detail.description: simple (default) = totals, tax, date and merchant. verbose = also line items, payment type, per-field metadata and enabled fraud/feature fields.

extract_time.description: true = return the time of day when found on the receipt (otherwise 12:00:00).

extract_line_items.description: Verbose only: false = skip line-item extraction (default true).

ignore_merchant_name.description: A name to ignore if detected as the merchant, such as a customer name.

language.description: Optional language hint (en, ar, kh, th, he, ...). Leave out for automatic detection.

near.description: A location (city, state, country) that helps identify the merchant.

keep_stored.description: Default false: the document and its extracted data are NOT stored by Taggun (incognito). true = Taggun stores them (up to 3 years), which enables later duplicate/similarity detection but keeps personal data from the receipt.

annotations.title: Scan a receipt or invoice from a URL

tools.name: taggun_scan_receipt_base64
tools.title: Scan a receipt or invoice from base64 data
tools.description: WRITE: this scan counts against YOUR Taggun quota and plan (free for the first 30 days or 1,000 scans, then billed per scan by Taggun), even if the receipt fails validation; it is never retried automatically. Extract structured data from a receipt or invoice sent as base64 (JPEG, PNG, GIF, HEIF/HEIC or PDF; the base64 text is capped at 2,000,000 characters, about 1.5 MB of file; for larger files use taggun_scan_receipt_url). POST /api/receipt/v1/{simple|verbose}/encoded.

tools.name: taggun_validate_receipt_campaign_url
tools.title: Validate a receipt against a stored campaign
tools.description: WRITE: this scan counts against YOUR Taggun quota and plan (free for the first 30 days or 1,000 scans, then billed per scan by Taggun), even if the receipt fails validation; it is never retried automatically. Document content is not logged by this server. Scan a receipt at a public https URL and check it against the rules of a campaign stored on your Taggun account (dates, merchants, products, balance owing, fraud checks). Returns pass/fail with reasons. Needs the Campaign Validation feature on your Taggun plan; use taggun_list_campaigns for the ids. Same URL rules as taggun_scan_receipt_url. POST /api/validation/v1/campaign/receipt-validation/url.

url.description: Public https URL of the receipt or invoice file.

language.description: Optional language hint (en, ar, kh, th, he, ...). Leave out for automatic detection.

near.description: A location (city, state, country) that helps identify the merchant.

keep_stored.description: Default false: the document and its extracted data are NOT stored by Taggun (incognito). true = Taggun stores them (up to 3 years), which enables later duplicate/similarity detection but keeps personal data from the receipt.

tools.name: taggun_list_campaigns
tools.title: List validation campaigns
tools.description: List the ids of the receipt-validation campaigns stored on your Taggun account (an empty list is normal). Does not use a scan. Needs the Campaign Validation feature; without it Taggun answers that the feature must be enabled. GET /api/validation/v1/campaign/settings/list.

tools.name: taggun_get_campaign
tools.title: Get a validation campaign's rules
tools.description: The stored validation rules of one campaign (dates, merchants, products, fraud checks, SmartValidate prompts). Does not use a scan. GET /api/validation/v1/campaign/settings/{campaignId}.

tools.name: taggun_export_reference_data
tools.title: Export account reference data (CSV)
tools.description: Read the reference data stored on your Taggun account as CSV: product_categories (the category taxonomy), known_merchants (merchant names and locations used for matching) or product_codes (expected product codes). Read-only; does not use a scan. The text is cut at 40,000 characters. GET /api/account/v1/{product-categories|known-merchants|known-product-codes}/export.
